executableContent.instructions: Ricky sedang mengerjakan proyek Matematika. Dia mencoba membuat konverter radian dan derajat menggunakan Python, tetapi lupa mengimpor modulnya. Bantu Ricky mengimpor package `math`.

files.name: script.py
files.solvedContent:
import math

def degree_to_radian(degree):
    print(f'{degree} degree = {math.radians(degree)} radian')

def radian_to_degree(radian):
    print(f'{radian} radian = {math.degrees(radian)} degree')

degree_to_radian(90)
radian_to_degree(0.785)

executableContent.instructions: Sebagai bagian dari riset untuk artikel yang sedang ditulisnya, Mia membuat program untuk mendapatkan harga median properti perumahan di suatu area. Programnya berjalan dengan baik, tetapi karena dia hanya menggunakan 1 fungsi, kita tidak perlu mengimpor seluruh modul `statistics`. **Ubah** pernyataan impornya agar hanya mengimpor fungsi `median` dari modul `statistics`. Kemudian hapus `statistics` saat menggunakan fungsi `median`.

files.name: script.py
files.content:
import statistics

prices = [300000, 270000, 389000, 295000, 321000, 288000, 232000, 200000,323000]
result = statistics.median(prices)
print(f"Median property price for the area is ${result}")
files.solvedContent:
from statistics import median

prices = [300000, 270000, 389000, 295000, 321000, 288000, 232000, 200000,323000]
result = median(prices)
print(f"Median property price for the area is ${result}")

executableContent.instructions: Sebagai manajer klub basket, Kugo sedang membuat tabulasi dan menganalisis performa klub. Kugo mendapati bahwa `statistics` terlalu panjang untuk diketik dan ingin menyederhanakannya menjadi `s`, tetapi dia lupa mengganti nama modul saat mengimpornya. Bantu Kugo mengganti nama impornya menjadi `s`.

files.name: script.py
files.content:
import statistics

scores = [87, 76, 75, 65, 54, 50, 43, 23, 56, 68, 97]
print(f'The highest score the team scored was {max(scores)}')
print(f'The lowest score the team scored was {min(scores)}')
print(f'The average score the team scored was {s.mean(scores)}')
print(f'The median score the team scored was {s.median(scores)}')
files.solvedContent:
import statistics as s

scores = [87, 76, 75, 65, 54, 50, 43, 23, 56, 68, 97]
print(f'The highest score the team scored was {max(scores)}')
print(f'The lowest score the team scored was {min(scores)}')
print(f'The average score the team scored was {s.mean(scores)}')
print(f'The median score the team scored was {s.median(scores)}')
